decisions.reason: Process data archiving software is close to the core offer, costs little to keep available, supports the firm's push toward data-driven infrastructure management, and its own dedicated page shows the firm is still committed to it while its value plays out.

This second archiving and reporting product overlaps with A and is only mentioned on the website, so it could be merged into A, but one year of evidence is too little to settle its value and software is cheap to maintain.

The manhole floor door with integrated safety railing is a low-cost hardware extension with its own page, serves safety needs of municipal water operators, and nothing so far shows its value won't be realized.

The floating sludge extractor builds on the established tank equipment line, and since infrastructure projects take long sales cycles, its prospects are still uncertain enough to keep the option open at modest cost.
Control technology for water engineering machinery fits the firm's integration and automation strategy and complements its machinery, so keeping it is cheap and it has strategic value.
